description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that gives you Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance—optimized for serverless, edge, AI‑first and LLM‑powered APIs.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the "zero‑dependency + edge‑ready" combo that no other major framework touts. Position yantravese v0.0.151‑daily as the go‑to choice for developers building AI‑augmented, LLM‑driven back‑ends and serverless functions on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, or Bun. Highlight the daily‑release cadence and 30‑commit activity to signal active maintenance, while the concise API surface (≈30 KB) beats Express/Fastify on cold‑start time and bundle size—key metrics in 2026’s performance‑first ecosystem.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for sub‑millisecond routing latency and near‑zero cold‑start on edge platforms.
Zero external dependencies mean smaller Docker images, faster CI pipelines, and no dependency‑drift headaches.
Type‑first API with full ESM and TypeScript support eliminates boilerplate and gives IDE auto‑completion out of the box.
Built‑in observability hooks (request tracing, metrics, error aggregation) let you monitor performance without extra packages.
Daily release cadence guarantees you get the latest security patches and performance tweaks without waiting for major version bumps.
